<book(79)>Great Wall<endbook()>.
<on()><sp(20)>That's a space where the laws of physics don't apply.

<on()><sp(20)>Not long after the <book(69)>Scub<endbook()> appeared on

<on()><sp(20)>But it wasn't fully in time, and a space
where the <book(77)>Limit of Questions<endbook()> began

to that <book(79)>Great Wall<endbook()>?

<on()><sp(20)>That's a door <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> and <color(4)>Renton<ce()> are the key to.
That's all you need to know for now.

<on()><sp(20)>The <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()> is a ship.
And <book(70)>Trapar<endbook()> is the wind
that guides us to that ship.

<on()><sp(20)>The <book(64)>Compac<endbook()> is what links us to <book(70)>Trapar<endbook()>.

<book(69)>Scub<endbook()>, each shaping the other.

rows.target:

becoming one with the <book(69)>Scub<endbook()>.

this world's law.
